title: Mars at opposition
note: Mars brightest and up all night — orange beacon in the east after dusk.

title: Total solar eclipse
note: Totality path crosses Greenland, Iceland, and Spain — not visible from the US.

title: Jupiter–Venus conjunction
note: Two brightest planets within 2° in the western sky after sunset.

title: Saturn at opposition
note: Rings tilt favorably — golden steady light in the evening sky.

title: Orionid meteor shower peak
note: Watch Orion after midnight — moon-free windows are best.

title: Leonid meteor shower peak
note: Radiant rises after midnight in Leo.

title: Geminid meteor shower peak
note: Often the year's richest shower — allow 20 minutes for dark adaptation.

title: Total lunar eclipse
note: Visible across the Americas — copper Moon in Earth's shadow.
